_purpose: YOLO-World single-config JOINT grid, pooled mAP@50 over all 13 conditions. CHARACTERIZATION of SATURATION, not an expected win: YOLO-World-TRUST is already ~+0.02 over its vanilla and its cache is reliable (margin correct), so cache-admission tuning adds little. The ONLY headroom is RANKING, so this grid centers on score-modulation / track params (score_blend_lambda, confirmed_track_boost, untracked_penalty, track_creation_threshold). Expectation: FLAT. Grid is deliberately SMALL (54 combos) to confirm the ceiling, not chase it.
_runner: MUST be run with grid_search/narval/grid_search_runner_multidet.py (stock runner hardcodes GroundingDINODetector). YOLO-World needs ultralytics installed in the pinned venv.
_stack: PINNED transformers==4.57.6 (+ ultralytics). Fixed: native_candidate_selection=true, health_gate_untracked=true, detector.threshold=0.1, iou=0.7. data_root + detector.model_path injected at run time by the sbatch (top-level).

_grid_design.current_value_in_every_set: score_blend_lambda=0.5, boost=0.07, untracked_penalty=0.01, tcr=0.65 all present -> frozen config is in the grid
_grid_design.chunk_axis: adaptation.params.score_blend_lambda (first swept param, length 3) -> 3 array chunks x 18 configs
_grid_design.expectation: flat / saturation; ranking params unlikely to move pooled mAP@50 materially
